title: A developer who learns by building.
intro: I am Mostafijur — a software engineer based in Dhaka, currently working as an Executive at AristoPharma Ltd. I completed my B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering at Eastern University in 2019, followed by an M.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering at Jahangirnagar University in 2026.
paragraphs: I like turning ideas into practical, user-friendly applications. My curiosity sits at the intersection of software, databases and thoughtful system design: how the pieces fit together, and how they can make an everyday problem a little easier.

Most of what I know comes from hands-on work. I build a project, test it, find what breaks, and refine it. That loop — build, learn, improve, share — is how I keep growing, and it is the idea behind this site.
